headline: India’s Power Plants Held 19 Million Tonnes of Coal at September End
deck: Coal stocks at India’s power plants stood at 19 million tonnes at September end; power-sector rake loadings reached 469 a day from October 1 to 10.
body: Reuters reported that Central Electricity Authority data put 96 of India’s 191 coal-fired power plants at critical coal-stock levels, defined as less than three days of fuel. [E1]
Financial Express reported that coal stock at India’s power plants stood at 19 million tonnes at the end of September, compared with 47 million tonnes a year earlier. [E2]
India’s Coal Ministry said rakes loaded to the power sector averaged 469 a day from October 1 to 10, compared with 426 a day in September. [E3]
